# DEV Community

> > DEV Community is a collaborative platform for software developers to share knowledge, build projects, and advance their careers through discussions, challenges, and learning resources.

DEV Community is built on the Forem platform and serves as a hub for web developers, AI enthusiasts, and programmers worldwide. The platform features user-generated content, educational tracks, hackathons, and community challenges alongside tools and partnerships from major tech companies like Google.

## Key Topics

- Web Development
- Artificial Intelligence
- JavaScript
- Programming
- Open Source

## Getting Started

- [DEV Community](https://dev.to): DEV Community homepage: software development discussion & career management

- [DEV Help - DEV Community](https://dev.to/help): DEV Help documentation: getting started, account management, features guide

## Learning & Development

- [DEV Education Tracks - DEV Community](https://dev.to/deved): DEV Education Tracks: hands-on learning platform with Google AI Studio

- [DEV Online Hackathons and Writing Challenges - DEV Community](https://dev.to/challenges): DEV hackathons and writing challenges for skill-building and portfolio projects

## Community Topics

- [Web Development - DEV Community](https://dev.to/t/webdev): Web development content: JavaScript, design, security, project showcase
- [Artificial Intelligence - DEV Community](https://dev.to/t/ai): AI community content: Google Gemini, AI projects, writing challenges
- [Programming - DEV Community](https://dev.to/t/programming): Programming content: web dev, AI agents, Linux, software architecture
- [JavaScript - DEV Community](https://dev.to/t/javascript): JavaScript tutorials: Node.js, performance, backend development
